title: WEB-2: Attach the ultrastable domains to the site, remove `noindex`, switch footer to the license notice
body:
**Owner:** Ops
**Trigger:** IP-5
**Done check:** Domains serve the site over HTTPS
**Status:** closed

Source of truth: `docs/roadmap.md` (item WEB-2). Every closed item proposes a plus: file it as a new issue labeled `plus`.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 273.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
